basis: Viewed PNGs rendered from actual reopened exported plate STEP files
observations: B210 has four recessed housing countersinks between four outer panel-stud clearance holes, continuous seating face and R8 outline.
Bedrock has six device bores/lands, four outer stud clearances, connected shallow field and two escape grooves on each face. Upper and lower land sizes differ intentionally.
The bottom view appears mirrored by viewing direction; feature coordinates remain in the unchanged source XY frame. The escape grooves are at source +X.
No missing profile segments, broken corners or stray machining geometry observed. Shallow fields appear almost flat because depth is 0.05 mm; the numeric specification controls machining.
limits: Visual inspection does not establish FPE process capability, received hardware geometry, physical fit, preload, conductivity or system load/thermal performance.
